projects.title: Prefix Treatment and Bayesian Partial Pooling for Early-Stage Lifetime Prediction from Degradation Data
projects.description: Bayesian partial pooling and prefix-based lifetime estimation for laser and battery degradation.
projects.data: Code only. The original laser and Oxford battery inputs are required for full reruns.
projects.authors: C. C. Zhang, X. Feng, and J. Jiang
projects.venue: Journal of Dynamics, Monitoring and Diagnostics

projects.title: Variable-length multiobjective optimization of inspection schedules for condition-based maintenance of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers under imperfect detection
projects.description: Single and multiple inspection decisions, fixed and variable-length schedules, and imperfect detection.
projects.data: The existing public archive is preserved. It includes processed data and analysis scripts.
projects.authors: C. C. Zhang, X. Feng, and H. Zhang

projects.title: Rapid stress birefringence mapping in mounted curved lenses with a curved layer Jones approximation
projects.description: A self-contained chain from elastic finite-element analysis to curved-layer Jones calculations and figure-ready outputs.
projects.data: Numerical analysis runs without an external mesh or measured stress field. Archived computed tables support figure generation.
projects.authors: C. C. Zhang, S. Zhang, H. Lou, J. Jiang, L. Sheng, and G. Markou

projects.title: Nonhomogeneous hidden semi-Markov modeling for censored accelerated degradation tests of blue laser diodes
projects.description: Covariate-dependent semi-Markov estimation, state-age filtering, and remaining-life prediction with censored laser histories.
projects.data: Pseudo-data are included for demonstration. Full measured-laser reruns require the original life-test records. See the archive README for the pseudo-data workflow.
projects.authors: C. C. Zhang, X. Feng, and J. Jiang

projects.title: Segmental Viterbi estimation using transition constraints for covariate-dependent hidden semi-Markov degradation models with right censoring
projects.description: Operational threshold constraints, exact segmental estimation, and filtering for ordered first-passage prediction.
projects.data: The website release includes illustrative pseudo-data, not original laser measurements. A DOI archive deposit is planned at or before final acceptance.
projects.authors: C. C. Zhang, X. Feng, and J. Jiang
